description: Register a media file as an asset. The app probes the file and supplies its metadata. Importing a uri that is already registered changes nothing.

uri.description: Content or file uri of the media.

hasVideo.description: Whether the media has a video stream.

hasAudio.description: Whether the media has an audio stream.

width.description: Video width in pixels; required for video.

height.description: Video height in pixels; required for video.

frameRate.description: Native frame rate of the video.

displayName.description: Name to show for the asset.
